管子主要由竹材製成，管身採用優質毛竹或蘆竹製作，具有良好的音響特性。雙簧片由蘆葦: The guanzi is made mainly of bamboo: the body uses good mao bamboo or reed bamboo, which has good acoustic properties. The double reed is made from a slip of reed and is the key part for sounding; it has to be chosen and worked with care. The inside and the surface of the body are polished, and some finer guanzi use decorative rings of wood or bone. The edges of the fingerholes are sometimes bound with ox bone or bamboo to make them last longer. The whole construction is fine and the parts fit closely together, so that the tone stays bright and penetrating.
